name: DealCloud
one_liner: DealCloud offers REST APIs and an official MCP integration for managing CRM data, schemas, users, backups, and real-time publications.
access_note: The provided documentation does not specify developer registration terms, pricing tiers, or how to obtain site credentials.

evidence.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token, which is then used in the HTTP Authentication header for API requests.
This site provides a comprehensive overview of our REST APIs, their capabilities, and available endpoints.
DealCloud MCP uses OAuth to authenticate, letting AI assistants connect on behalf of an individual user.
